items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: he plays with me up til now

ctx.x: Yeah, we played together quite a bit. Fishin' too. He's a fisherman boy. Yep, one of the best fishermen there is. When I go to Montauk, man he takes me out a lotta times. He has his boat, you know, and he catches big fish... And there's Earl Womack, a bass player -- he plays with me up til now, and a little piano player --
Now these guys couldn't read. Now how a saxophone player could learn how to play without readin' is beyond me...
